name: io.github.KKazuhaK/anteater-mcp
title: Anteater MCP
description: Course search and registration planning for UC Irvine: live section availability, grade distributions by professor, enrollment history, prerequisite checking and schedule conflict detection.

environmentVariables.name: ANTEATER_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret clients must present as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Required before exposing the server beyond loopback.

environmentVariables.name: ANTEATER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Anteater API key. Optional, but anonymous calls share a global hourly quota. Request one at https://dashboard.anteaterapi.com and choose type 'secret'.

environmentVariables.name: ANTEATER_TRUSTED_PROXIES
environmentVariables.description: Which peers may set X-Forwarded-*. Defaults to 'private', which covers the Docker bridge. Without it the server ignores forwarded headers, because they are client-supplied.

environmentVariables.name: ZOTCOURSE_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Independent fallback for live schedule data when Anteater API is unavailable. Set to 'off' to disable.
